tasks.title: Add issue lifecycle state helpers
tasks.description: Implement shared domain helpers that define current-stage approval validity and merge delivery classification for issues. The helpers should make stale approval inert and classify false-done states such as done/completed with missing or non-merged merge state.
acceptanceCriteria: A current-stage approval helper returns true only when approvalState.stage equals the issue stage and the optional status matches
Stale awaiting, approved, and rejected approval states are classified as not current-stage approval
A merge delivery classifier distinguishes merged, queued, merging, conflict/build-failed/blocked, not-ready/not-merged, unknown, and done-not-merged states
Unit tests cover mergeState null across draft/plan/build/check/done and done/completed + null as an anomaly
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer a small pure module that can be used by workflow, API, storage, CLI formatting, and tests without introducing a database migration.

tasks.title: Harden stage-aware approval consumption
tasks.description: Apply the current-stage approval helper to all workflow and approval lookup paths. UserApprovalCheck, Plan runner skip logic, pending approval queries, paused-agent detection, blocked resume logic, approve, and reject must ignore stale approval state and only act on the current stage.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan-stage approved approvalState does not make Check-stage UserApprovalCheck pass
Only current-stage awaiting approval is returned by pending approval lookup methods and approval APIs
Stale approved and rejected approval states do not pass or fail checks for the current stage
Consumed Plan approval is cleared or made inert before Build/Check can observe it
Regression tests cover stale Plan approval leaking into Check and stale awaiting approval not being approvable
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Search for direct approvalState.status checks and replace only lifecycle-driving checks, preserving historical display where appropriate.

tasks.title: Gate completion on successful merge
tasks.description: Change Check completion so passing checks and user approval do not directly mark the issue done. Check approval must enqueue the merge queue, and only an idempotent merge-success transition may set stage=done and status=completed.
acceptanceCriteria: Check stage completion without current user approval leaves the issue awaiting approval instead of done
Approving a current Check approval calls mergeQueue.enqueue and returns a queued-for-merge API message
WorkflowEngine and CheckStageRunner no longer complete an issue as done/completed merely because Check checks passed
Merge success transition is idempotent and is the only path that writes done/completed for merged Check issues
Tests prove done/completed is not written until mergeState is merged
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/src/workflow, packages/cli/src/api/issues.ts, packages/cli/src/git/merge-queue.ts, packages/cli/src/server/index.ts, and tests
tasks.notes: Keep the persisted stage model as plan/build/check/done; represent the merge gate through Check + mergeState rather than adding a new database stage.

tasks.title: Guard false-done recovery and archive flows
tasks.description: Use the merge delivery classifier to detect issues that are marked done/completed without a merged merge state. Recovery/status paths should make this anomaly visible, and archive-all-completed must not silently archive false-done issues.
acceptanceCriteria: done/completed issues with mergeState null or non-merged are classified as false-done anomalies
Agent recovery/status surfaces false-done issues as recoverable or anomalous instead of treating them as safely completed
archiveAllCompleted archives only trusted merged completed issues and skips false-done issues with a clear message or warning
Single issue archive returns a visible warning or blocking error when the issue is false-done
Regression tests cover done/completed + merge_state null archive and recovery behavior
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not backfill historical rows to merged; the goal is to expose untrusted completion state.

tasks.title: Expose merge trust in CLI output
tasks.description: Update CLI issue formatting so users can see merge status without inferring it from stage and status. `mo issue show` should display merge state, source/target branch context where available, and false-done warnings; `mo issue approve` should print the API-provided action message.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue show displays merged, queued/merging, conflict/build-failed/blocked, not merged/unknown, and done-not-merged states from issue data
mo issue show highlights done/completed + missing or non-merged mergeState as a warning
mo issue approve prints the API response message and distinguishes resumed pipeline from queued for merge
Issue list or status formatting shows a merge warning badge/marker for false-done issues when such issues are listed
CLI formatting tests cover null mergeState in multiple stages and false-done output
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: If source/target branch metadata is not stored, derive best-effort values from issue number and project baseBranch without adding schema.

tasks.title: Expose merge trust in Web UI
tasks.description: Update the Web UI to make merge delivery status visible on issue detail and issue cards. MergeStatePanel must render a stable merge box even when mergeState is null, and approval labels must describe resume/build or queue-merge actions instead of saying Approve & Done.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue detail renders a merge status box for null mergeState with Not ready, Not merged, Unknown, or Done but not merged semantics
Issue detail and cards display merged, queued/merging/rebasing/resolving, conflict/build-failed/blocked, and false-done states distinctly
Done column cards for unmerged or unknown merge status show a warning badge or marker
Check approval button no longer says Approve & Done and instead communicates queue merge or merge-to-target intent
Plan approval copy communicates approving design and starting/resuming build
Web component or formatting tests cover null mergeState and done/completed anomaly rendering
Typecheck passes
tasks.output: packages/cli/web/src/components/*, packages/cli/web/src/lib/*, and Web UI tests
tasks.notes: Preserve the existing visual language; this is a clarity fix, not a redesign.

tasks.title: Add end-to-end regression coverage
tasks.description: Add focused regression coverage tying together approval lifecycle, merge-gated completion, CLI formatting, Web formatting, and archive guardrails. These tests should prevent recurrence of the #135 false-done path where Check user-approval passes from stale Plan approval and no merge queue entry exists.
acceptanceCriteria: A regression test reproduces stale Plan approval at Check and verifies Check requests fresh approval instead of passing
A regression test verifies Check approve enqueues merge and issue remains not completed until merge success
A regression test verifies done/completed + mergeState null is displayed or reported as an anomaly in backend/API-facing output
A regression test verifies archive-all-completed does not silently archive false-done issues
CLI and Web formatting tests cover mergeState null state matrix
npm test passes in packages/cli
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is the final safety-net task after implementation tasks have landed; keep tests deterministic and avoid requiring real remote merges.
